source_findings.detail: Both students are slices of the returned fused 5632-D retrieval descriptor, full output[1][:,5120:] and partial query[:,5120:], hence exactly coordinates 5120:5632 for these parents. They retain gradients and use the same existing shared_neck and shared_classifier. The expert parent puts M/F/I residual contributions into that public outlet before metric normalization. No raw-base or standalone-expert substitute is used.

Builder fixes public_identity_weight=.1 on all four variants. Additional terms are .05 times full CE and .05 times partial CE, using the existing CrossEntropyLabelSmooth with epsilon .1 and current official training identity target. They do not receive the .25 original ID-loss coefficient again. Original weighted full CE/triplet pairs, final auxiliary scalar, .25 partial fused CE and .5 stopped-full-gallery triplet are retained. Training labels are relabeled only from the complete official training split; the existing evaluator does not call this training update or supply identity labels to the inference forward.

Expert variants use the unchanged M4 builder: original_mean pooling, measurement_only gates, relation_weight=.1, F alignment_weight=.1 at temperature .07, and PM alignment_weight=.1. Alignment names are assigned before the forward; existing full-view PM/F and relation losses remain in the returned odd auxiliary scalar and their audits are retained after the partial pass. Gate detach behavior is inherited. demo_shared uses the original full-official SharedIdentityDeMo builder. No M5 graph model, loss, teacher projection, reference cycle, or source sampler is imported into the reviewed update.

After the variant assertion, zero weight immediately calls the original shared parent step for demo_shared or original M4 parent step for each expert variant, adds reporting fields, and returns. No new tensor transfer, alignment assignment, hook, forward, CE, RNG consumption, optimizer reset or BN call precedes the parent call. Numerical parent equivalence and native Adam updates remain unmeasured here.

The full original-plus-extra loss is backpropagated before partial backbone execution, without retain_graph. output and full_public are deleted; the full fused gallery is detached. Remaining scalar loss references do not request saved-tensor retention after backward. Partial original-plus-extra loss accumulates into the same optimizer gradients, followed by the original single unscale/step/update sequence. New code adds only two shared-head applications, with no extra backbone forward, model parameter, forward hook, teacher queue or feature bank. Actual B64 peak memory is pending native measurement.

In a positive training step shared_neck is used three times in order: original raw full shared512, actual normalized full public512, actual normalized partial public512. This is two additional training BN calls for every variant and intentionally changes its running buffers. The report field discloses +2; it is a declaration, not a measured contract. Positive native validation must capture these three inputs and the +2 num_batches_tracked effect, allowing the intended extra running-stat updates. Existing eval returns the descriptor without this classification head.
